title: My City
publicSourceReferences: KOSMOS / Thames & Kosmos Official My City Rulebook & Chapter Envelopes

milestones.title: The New Land
milestones.description: Laying the initial foundations along the riverbank in an untouched valley between mountains and forests.

milestones.title: The Churches
milestones.description: Constructing grand places of worship to unite the community as open land becomes increasingly contested.

milestones.title: The Flooding
milestones.description: Adapting urban growth as seasonal river waters rise, challenging planners to protect residential zones.

milestones.title: The Gold Rush
milestones.description: Valuable veins discovered in the foothills trigger fierce expansion and lucrative territorial competition.

milestones.title: The Factories
milestones.description: Smokestacks rise across the district as manufacturing drives rapid urban productivity and structural shifts.

milestones.title: The Mining
milestones.description: Deep mineral shafts reshape the outskirts, providing raw materials to fuel further civic development.

milestones.title: The Railroad
milestones.description: Iron tracks connect distant corners of the township, transforming logistics and spatial planning.

milestones.title: The Prosperity
milestones.description: Culmination of generations of planning into an enduring, prosperous city with its own distinct legacy.
